description.text:
The XY Trainer Kit: Pikachu Libre & Suicune, released on 27 April 2016, was the fourth kit of the XY Series. Its two 30-card half decks, each with one foil card, came with two guided game booklets, a playmat with rules on the back, counters, a Pikachu coin, a deck box and a code card. Its Pikachu Libre and Suicune cards are the kit's own. The cards carry the kit's own set symbol and no rarity mark, numbered in the order the example battle draws them. In the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online, the code unlocked the two halves combined as the Swift Current theme deck.

The Suicune half deck runs on Water Energy, numbered 1/30 to 30/30.

sources.title: Bulbapedia: XY Trainer Kit: Pikachu Libre & Suicune (TCG) (Wayback Machine copy, 12 July 2026)
